verdict.rationale: Runpod hosts customer workloads and offers Public Endpoints for AI models, so a no-training data policy or opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no such policy or control. The closest items are multi-tenant container isolation and partner SOC 2/ISO certifications, which concern access by other users and security posture rather than use of data for model training. These are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
